falsifiers.condition: Draft validation accepts checks_enabled=false with any non-disabled status/code pair.
Draft validation accepts checks_enabled=true with NOT_RUN_TREATMENT_DISABLED status or code.
Draft and runtime disagree for any of the six ordered checks or any projection site.
Any caller can provide/select provider schema, adapter type, publication driver, driver identity, material profile, provider root, or executable.
Adapter/driver/material-profile bytes differ from the two exact sealed bindings without a new design and review.
Owner UID is not exact, or symlink/non-regular/wrong-mode/path substitution can satisfy custody.
Any fact lacks exactly resolved citation/source lineage or any tuple field can be omitted/substituted.
A direct/transitive production or test consumer, hash claim, path claim, or schema projection is absent from the registered graph.
Crash/restart/STOP/UNKNOWN/ambiguous commit permits provider replay, retry, status query, optimistic PASS, or denominator removal.
Final closure, producer evidence, or independent review is emitted before all consumer bytes and semantic edges are stable.
P0-v9 CLEAN producer/review or embedded v8 OPEN history is mutated, relabeled, or silently invalidated.
Design artifacts activate/register/count cells, call provider/network/bytedcli, mutate scheduler/email/business state, or claim intended-runtime acceptance.
Runner-v2, Codex-v6, Claude-v8, or P0-v10 is represented CLEAN without a fresh exact-byte independent review.
Catalog membership evidence is treated as inference readiness or later STOP history is erased.

The contradicted blind-map-v5 CLEAN receipt is used as current authority, the exact 13-finding OPEN review is omitted, or final closure proceeds without future blind-map-v6 exact contract/closure/producer and CLEAN review.
Execution-window-v1 bytes are represented as current execution-window-v2, or v2 template/closure/review is sealed without exact bytes.
Runner-v2 public PREDECESSOR is mutable, differs from internal binding, is not exact-source rehashed/reservation-key bound, is caller-replaceable, or lacks fresh review.
Claude-v8 OPEN review is promoted to CLEAN despite its closure descriptor mislabel, its exact OPEN history is rewritten, or final closure proceeds without future evidence-only Claude-v9 CLEAN.

Runner-v2 OPEN is promoted to CLEAN, mutable exported identity can split reservation keys, indeterminate process observation can permit takeover, the P0 checks_enabled schema finding is dropped, or final closure proceeds without runner-v3 CLEAN.

problem_benefit_cost.benefit: One frozen graph and falsifiable protocol prevent silent lineage gaps, provider-identity substitution, duplicate boundary effects, and false CLEAN promotion.
problem_benefit_cost.cost: Local JSON/Python design artifacts and deterministic hashing only; no runtime edits or effects.
problem_benefit_cost.problem: Runner-v2 OPEN confirms mutable key authority, unsafe liveness-UNKNOWN takeover, and preserved P0 schema drift; blind-map-v5 and Claude-v8 are also OPEN. Missing runner-v3/blind-map-v6/Claude-v9 CLEAN and execution-window-v2 bytes prevent final closure.

review_questions: Does the conditional schema exactly reject both confirmed impossible combinations at both projection sites?
Are provider bindings sealed and absent from caller input?
Does the graph enumerate every existing direct/transitive production and test consumer plus additive runner/Codex/Claude consumers?
Do crash/restart/STOP/UNKNOWN paths remain retained and no-replay?
Is P0-v9 CLEAN preserved rather than silently invalidated?
Can any closure/producer/review be sealed before consumer bytes stabilize?
Is blind-map-v5 historical CLEAN evidence preserved only as contradicted history under the exact 13-finding OPEN review, with blind-map-v6 CLEAN required final-closure-last?
Is execution-window-v1 only a predecessor, with execution-window-v2 exact bytes/review unresolved?
Does runner-v2 public PREDECESSOR have closed immutable identity, exact source rehash, reservation-key binding, caller-substitution denial, and future review?
Is CLEAN Codex-v6 treated strictly as an exact consumer input ready for closure-last, never as P0-v10 final authority?
Is Claude-v8 preserved exactly OPEN for descriptor mislabel despite technical parity PASS, with evidence-only Claude-v9 CLEAN required final-closure-last?
Is runner-v2 preserved exact OPEN for mutable key authority, liveness UNKNOWN takeover, and P0 schema drift, with runner-v3 CLEAN required final-closure-last?
